title: A support answer
situation: A client, Dr. Lena Vos's dental practice, writes: How do I change our opening hours on the website? We now close at 5 pm on Fridays. In the agency's site editor, hours live under Settings, then Business info.
goal: Write a prompt that gets the AI to draft a clear, friendly reply.

details.label: Who the AI should be
details.hint: Who should the AI be? A friendly support agent at a web agency.

details.label: A reply to the client
details.hint: What should it write? A reply to the client's question.

details.label: The client's exact question
details.hint: What exactly is the client asking? Paste their question about the opening hours.

details.label: Where the setting is
details.hint: Where is the setting? Tell the AI: Settings, then Business info.

details.label: Who the client is
details.hint: Who is the client? Mention Dr. Vos's dental practice.

details.label: Easy steps
details.hint: What shape? Numbered steps are easy to follow.

details.label: A simple, kind tone
details.hint: What tone? Friendly and simple: the client isn't technical.

details.label: An example to follow
details.hint: Bonus: show how you usually start a reply, so the AI can match it.

details.label: A rule to respect
details.hint: Bonus: add a rule, like don't use technical terms.

conflicts.explain: One sentence and numbered steps at the same time? The roof cracks. Steps work better here.

answers.vague: Thank you for your message. You can change your opening hours in the website settings. Let us know if you need anything else.
answers.passable:
Hi Dr. Vos,

You can update your opening hours in the website editor. Go to the settings and change Friday's closing time to 5 pm. Let us know if you need help!
answers.excellent:
Hi Dr. Vos,

Good news, it only takes a minute:
1. Log in to your website editor.
2. Open Settings, then Business info.
3. Under Opening hours, set Friday to close at 5 pm.
4. Click Save. The change is live straight away.

If anything looks off, just reply to this email and we'll sort it out.

Best wishes,
The support team

ada.intro: A client needs help. Write a prompt for a reply they can follow without calling you back.
ada.success: It holds! The AI knew the exact question, where the setting lives and how to explain it simply.
ada.takeaway: For support answers, give the AI the client's exact question and the facts it can't know.
